description: Encode UTF-8 text as Base64 (standard or URL-safe alphabet), identical to the Toolars base64-encoder-decoder web tool. Runs entirely locally; no network or filesystem access. Input and result enter the MCP client context and may be sent to its model provider.

text.description: UTF-8 text to process. Nothing is read from files or URLs.

urlSafe.description: Use the URL-safe alphabet (- and _) and omit padding.

name: toolars_base64_encode
